name: hakuneko
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow Tier A behavior for this primary application updater: HakuNeko contains a hardcoded RSA public key in application configuration; the updater uses this independent key to verify the signed cache payload.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact signing or deployment state beyond the checked-in pinned key/configuration.
Framework verification depends on the packaged updater implementation where the application delegates to Sparkle or tauri-plugin-updater.
